article.title: Quiz: fill in the correct preposition
article.description: Quiz format: 'She has been working ___ this company ___ five years. a) at / for  b) in / since  c) at / since  d) on / for' Answer: a) 'at this company' and 'for five years' (duration). Teaching point: use 'since' with a starting point in time, 'for' with a duration.
article.content: Quiz format: 'She has been working ___ this company ___ five years. a) at / for  b) in / since  c) at / since  d) on / for' Answer: a) 'at this company' and 'for five years' (duration). Teaching point: use 'since' with a starting point in time, 'for' with a duration.

generated.caption:
Ever get confused between 'for' and 'since' when talking about time? 🤔 You're not alone!

Here's the trick: Use 'for' to describe a *duration* (how long). Use 'since' to mark a *starting point* (when it began).

For example: She has been working *for* five years.

Easy, right? Save this post & follow @TheEnglishVault for daily English tips!
generated.script: Company ke saath 'at' ya 'in'? Aur 'for' five years ya 'since' five years? Ye confusion sabko hota hai! Dekho, jab hum kisi company mein kaam karne ki baat karte hain, toh mostly 'at' use karte hain. Jaise, 'She has been working at this company'. Samajh gaye? Ab time ke liye. 'For' use karte hain jab aap ek duration batate ho, kitne time se koi kaam ho raha hai. Jaise, 'for five years'. Aur 'since' tab use hota hai jab aap ek specific starting point ki baat karte ho, like 'since 2010'. Toh, the correct sentence is 'She has been working at this company for five years'. 'At' company ke liye aur 'for' duration ke liye. Ab clear ho gaya na? Comment mein batao aapko ye rule pata tha ya nahi! Aur aise hi quick English tips ke liye The English Vault ko follow karo!

slides.body: Mastering prepositions like 'for' and 'since' is crucial for precise English. We use 'for' to express a duration of time, indicating how long something has lasted. For example, in 'She has been working at this company for five years,' 'for five years' tells us the total length of her employment. In contrast, 'since' refers to a specific starting point in time, like 'since 2018' or 'since Monday'. Remember, 'at' is used for specific locations, such as 'at this company'.
slides.hindiSummary: 'For' का प्रयोग समय की अवधि (कितने समय से) बताने के लिए किया जाता है, जबकि 'since' का प्रयोग समय के शुरुआती बिंदु (कब से) बताने के लिए होता है।
